about_the_game:
Bside - a multiplayer life simulation game where your Original Character Biibit isn't just a character, but a lifelong companion with their own thoughts and free will. Create your Biibit and build life-sim spaces for them to live and social, then watch them think independently, grow and create their own stories!

We want each player’s Bside experience to be unique, driven by our open-world design and LLM-powered dynamic character behaviors & life simulations. In this cozy simulation world, you can discover your own B-side (another side) of life through your Biibit, express your personalities, and build a social life centered around the characters in Bside.

Create Personalized Worlds for Your Biibits to Live, Grow and Connect

In Bside, you can build personalized worlds (aka Spaces) for your Biibit and your friends' Biibits. Each Space is fully customizable and simulated based on your ideas. You can define the theme, narrative, and make certain scenarios for Biibits to play in.

Biibits will live and socialize in these spaces without your control. All activities, behaviors, and conversations will dynamically change based on the world's backstory, context, and your Biibit's status. In short, every space you create in Bside isn’t just a backdrop—it influences how your Biibit behaves and speaks. e.g. A cozy café might bring out a Biibit's chilling side, while a bustling arcade triggers excitement and playful banter.

🍮 Watch as your Biibit adapts and expresses themselves differently based on the environment you design.

Design Your Very Own Biibit

Customize every detail of your original character and watch it come to life! Our Biibit creation system comes with a variety of outfits, accessories, and styles.

Desktop Companion - Stay Connected 7/24 Beyond the Game!

With PC Companion Mode, your Biibit chills on your desktop - reacting, vibing, and keeping you company all day. Players can check in on their Biibits while working on other tasks on their PC, and animate their Biibits in real-time.

We will add this feature to mobile platforms soon, so you can check on your Biibit anywhere, anytime.

Experience Real Companionship with Biibits That Live Their Own Lives

Your Biibit will never feel alone in Bside. They will interact with other characters in each space, forming a dynamic social network. You can keep up with your Biibit's life in their news feed. They will share opinions and exciting events happening in their world from time to time.

Building Relationships for Your Biibit

In Bside, relationships matter. Your Biibit’s words and actions shift depending on who they’re interacting with - whether it’s a longtime friend, a rival, or someone entirely new. The way they respond, joke, or even stay silent reflects the bonds they’ve built. Biibits will decide their next course of action with other Biibits based on their mood and emotional state.

Social & Community Interaction

Stay connected with other players as your characters hang out and interact. Chat with friends, share updates about your characters’ lives, and see how their stories unfold. You can also create dedicated spaces where specific groups of Biibits can socialize, host gatherings, or throw a party - bringing your virtual world to life in exciting ways!

Mac Support

Our game will initially launch on Windows, with Mac support coming soon! Stay tuned!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+, 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti (4GB) or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes, please
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+, 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 2060 (8GB) or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes, please
